candidates.location_hint: the custom checkbox inputs and their sibling visual boxes
candidates.why: custom visuals often risk losing native state announcements or keyboard operability if the hidden input isn't properly managed; worth verifying screen reader feedback and focus behavior.

candidates.location_hint: the apply button and its disabled styling
candidates.why: uses both native disabled attribute and aria-disabled on the same element, which is redundant but worth checking for assistive technology compatibility.

candidates.location_hint: the helper text paragraph below the apply button
candidates.why: light gray text color might be worth verifying against minimum contrast thresholds for supporting text on varying displays.

candidates.location_hint: the focus indicators applied to all interactive controls
candidates.why: reliance solely on :focus-visible without a fallback may leave older browsers or non-standard input methods without visible focus feedback; worth confirming consistent visibility.

candidates.location_hint: the region dropdown and its associated label
candidates.why: ensure the label is programmatically bound correctly and that the dropdown's state changes are properly announced to assistive technology.
